title: Agent capability profile
description: Declarative description of one agent's skill format support. Everything the converter needs to know about a target agent lives here; adding an agent should not require code unless the agent uses a non-SKILL.md format.

id.description: Stable machine identifier. Used as `--from`/`--to` value and as the profile filename stem.

aliases.description: Other names accepted wherever an agent id is, such as the binary name the agent's own documentation uses. An alias must not collide with another profile's id or alias; the loader rejects that rather than resolving it by file order.

format.description: `agent-skills` means the agent reads the Agent Skills layout natively and a data-only profile is sufficient. `proprietary` means a custom adapter is required.

delivery.description: How the agent receives a skill. `directory` means it reads a discovery root on disk, so `paths` must name at least one. `archive` means the skill is uploaded as a bundle and there is no root to write to, so `paths` must be empty and the converter writes a directory for you to upload rather than installing.

unknownFields.description: What to do with a frontmatter field this profile does not describe. `emit` keeps it verbatim and reports it as degraded, which is right for an agent that tolerates extra keys. `drop` removes it and reports it as dropped, which is right where the target validates a closed set of keys and an unrecognised one could fail the whole skill.

verification.description: `verified`: every encoded fact traced to a primary source. `partial`: at least one fact is inferred or only documented by a third party. `unverified`: profile is a placeholder.

fieldAliases.description: Maps a foreign spelling of a field to the spelling this agent uses, so the pipeline can rename instead of dropping. Only needed where agents disagree on capitalisation or separators.

fields.description: Per-frontmatter-field support. Keys are the field names as the target agent spells them. Any field absent from this map must be treated as `unknown` by the converter, which then warns instead of guessing.

extensions.description: Agent-specific behaviours with no equivalent elsewhere. Listed so the report can name what a conversion loses.

pathList.description: Empty only for an `archive` delivery, where the agent has no discovery root at all.

path.description: Use `~` for the user home, `<angle-brackets>` for values only known at runtime.

role.description: `compatibility` marks a directory the agent reads but does not own, such as OpenCode reading .claude/skills. Source detection only treats `native` roots as owners, so a compatibility source never makes a directory ambiguous.

precedence.description: Lower wins. null when the agent does not document an ordering.

skillDirDepth.description: How many directory levels below a root a skill directory may sit and still be found.

acceptsFlatMarkdown.description: Whether a bare `<name>.md` file is loaded as a skill, in addition to `<name>/SKILL.md`.

followsSymlinks.description: null when the agent does not document symlink handling. The converter must then warn rather than assume.

upwardSearch.description: Whether roots are also scanned in ancestor directories up to the repository root.

nestedLazyLoad.description: Whether skills in directories below the working directory load on demand instead of at startup.

pattern.description: ECMAScript regex the name must match, or null when the agent imposes no character grammar.

reserved.description: Substrings a name may not contain. An agent that reserves a word rejects the whole skill, so the converter reports it and leaves the rename to the author rather than inventing a new identity.

enforcement.description: What the agent does when a name violates the rules.

maxLength.description: Hard validation limit, or null when the agent never rejects an over-long description.

requiredInDirectoryForm.description: Whether a directory skill without a description is rejected or ignored.

requiredInFlatForm.description: Whether a flat .md skill without a description is rejected or ignored.

identity.description: Where the skill's addressable identity comes from. This decides which name the IR records and which directory name an emitter must use.

source.description: `path` means the file path determines the identity and frontmatter name is decoration.

requiredInDirectoryForm.description: Whether a directory skill with no identity is rejected.

requiredInFlatForm.description: Whether a flat .md skill with no identity is rejected.

displayNameFrom.description: Frontmatter field used as a human-facing label when the identity comes from the path.

bodyExecution.description: Whether the agent executes anything found in the skill body. The converter never executes; this only decides what must be reported and neutralised.

executed.description: `false` means no execution syntax is documented, not that a denial is documented.

invocation.description: How a user invokes a skill in this agent's chat, taken from the agent's own documentation. SP026 compares a skill's own text against this and warns when the text uses a syntax this agent does not provide. Absent or `unknown` means unverified, and no warning is raised.

syntax.description: The literal text a user types, with the skill's name written as `{name}`, for example `/{name}`, `${name}`, `@{name}` or `/skill:{name}`. `unknown` when the documentation states no per-skill invocation.

source.description: Official page that states the syntax. Required unless syntax is `unknown`.

note.description: Why the syntax is unknown, or a qualification the source makes, such as which forms are namespaced.

configurableBy.description: Config key that changes the bound, if any.

combinesWith.description: Other fields that count toward the same budget.

mapsTo.description: Target field that carries the same meaning, when it is spelled differently.

dropReason.description: Why this field must not be emitted, even when its status is `unknown` rather than `unsupported`. Use when the target's acceptance of the field is undocumented and emitting it would be a guess. Without this the converter emits an `unknown` field verbatim and reports it as degraded.

fieldStatus.description: supported: honoured with equivalent semantics. ignored: accepted but has no effect. emulated: the converter can approximate it through another mechanism. unsupported: no equivalent exists. unknown: not verified.

fidelityImpact.description: Best achievable outcome when this extension is present in the source and the target is another agent.

trigger.description: Optional machine-readable condition. When a skill's frontmatter matches, the rule engine can report the extension as at risk without any agent-specific code.

equals.description: Value the field must hold. Omit to match on presence alone.

source.description: A first-party page the profile's claims rest on. Re-fetch and re-date on every refresh.

retrieved.description: Date the URL was last fetched and its content checked against the claims below.

covers.description: Which parts of the profile this source substantiates. Lint cites the source that covers the rule's area.
